definitions.explanation: Experiencing good luck or a fortunate outcome, often used as an exclamation when something unexpectedly good happens.

examples.japanese: ラッキー！⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}い→空く：11062_aku⟧てた。
examples.english: Lucky! There was an open seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ラッキーな⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧だった。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{晴|は}れて→晴れる：00701_hareru⟧、ラッキーだった。
examples.english: Rain was forecast but it cleared up — I was lucky.

notes:
USAGE:
ラッキー is a casual, cheerful exclamation for small strokes of good luck. It is lighter and more informal than ⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧ (good fortune) or ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (to be lucky). It is frequently used as a standalone exclamation: ラッキー！

The opposite is アンラッキー, though this is less commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ラッキーな⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: lucky day
- ラッキーだった: was lucky
- ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧ラッキー: super lucky (casual intensifier)
